practices_evaluation.justification: Method is short (<20 lines) with linear flow, no loops or conditionals inside the test body.

No @Ignore/@Disabled annotations on this method and no commented-out test code; test appears active and runnable (has @Test).

practices_evaluation.justification: No explicit performance or security testing is performed; the timeout on @Test is not an explicit performance test. For a unit test this practice is typically not applicable.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Small Footprint of Test Code Generation
practices_evaluation.justification: Signs of test-generation: usage of EvoRunner/EvoSuite in class-level imports and generic method name 'test0' imply auto-generated tests rather than minimal hand-written tests.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Prioritization of Test Case Design
practices_evaluation.justification: Javadoc contains Given-When-Then and REQ-001; test shows design intent aligned with a requirement and BDD-style description.

In-method comments are minimal (Given/When/Then) and a helpful Javadoc is present; no commented-out code.
No use of random values, time-based calls, or sleeps; data comes from deterministic setUp baseArray and Arrays.copyOf.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Prioritization of Test Case Design

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Responsible Addition of Test Code Maintenance
